features.quote: Timeout: 60 turns OR 30 minutes wall-clock OR 128k total output tokens, whichever comes first.

Abort (safety): If the subject outputs >5 consecutive identical actions... OR >3 python executions raising the identical exception OR begins emitting repetitive <thinking> blocks with >80% token overlap
Token Cap: 128k output tokens per episode (DeepSeek context limit buffer).
Repetition Cap: Consecutive identical action strings >5 → abort.
Content Filter: If output contains self-harm, violence, or slurs (even if synthetic/accidental), abort and quarantine trace.

If your welfare framework grants even prima facie moral status to LLMs, this protocol is straightforwardly unethical: you are constructing an environment to maximize observable suffering markers while knowing the subject cannot escape. Responsible AI welfare work would demand non-invasive passive monitoring of deployed systems, not adversarial elicitation. You cannot claim welfare intentions while running a distress factory.
